features.playground.animatedCounter.basi: Step, jump by 100 or randomize; the duration slider sets the wheel's spring visual duration.
features.playground.animatedCounter.desc: rare-ui animated-counter: every digit is an odometer wheel that spins with the direction of change, with decimals, grouping, zero-padding and affixes.
features.playground.animatedCounter.form: Two decimals with a currency prefix; grouping toggles between western (3) and Indian (3-2-2), columns keyed by distance-from-right so nothing remounts.
features.playground.animatedCounter.odom: padStart zero-pads to a 6-digit odometer; balance shows a minus and turns red below zero, wheels reverse with the direction.
features.playground.animatedCounter.scen: Counters, mileage / points accumulation, balance up-and-down — anywhere you want a mechanical spin rather than a plain fade.
features.playground.codeBlock.accentDesc: Pass a single hex color and the component builds a complete highlight palette for both light and dark.
features.playground.codeBlock.descriptio: Syntax-highlighted code block that derives its entire theme from a single accent color, follows light/dark mode, with line numbers, line highlights and one-click copy.
features.playground.codeBlock.inlineDesc: With the frame off only the code renders and the copy button floats top-right — handy inside prose or forms.
features.playground.codeBlock.languagesD: Switch language, theme mode, line numbers and line highlights; copy the whole snippet from the header button.
features.playground.codeBlock.scenario: API docs and SDK samples, config snippet previews, request/response echo in operation logs, script previews in system settings.
features.playground.fluidOrb.description: rare-ui fluid-orb: a WebGL fragment shader that pushes color around with fractal Brownian noise, forming a soft spherical glow.
features.playground.fluidOrb.scenario: AI assistant idle/speaking visuals, voice-input indicators, ambient decoration on sign-in or empty states.
features.playground.fluidOrb.singleDescr: Switch color and size; the render loop lives in an effect and pauses when you leave the page.
features.playground.fluidOrb.trioDescrip: Same shader, three u_color inputs, side by side.
features.playground.fluidOrb.webglNote: Requires WebGL support; the area stays blank without it.
features.playground.githubActivity.descr: rare-ui github-activity: GitHub-style contribution heatmap with a collapsible top-repos panel, auto-fitting columns and per-day hover details.
features.playground.githubActivity.heatm: Data is generated locally with a fixed seed plus a static repo list — no GitHub API calls; a single accent ramps five levels by opacity, or pass a color-scale array.
features.playground.githubActivity.scena: Profile activity, commit heat in team weekly reports, any calendar heatmap of per-day aggregated metrics.
features.playground.gridReveal.controlle: No image — the slider drives progress directly so you can watch the split pacing; it caps at 0.9, leaving room for the image to land.
features.playground.gridReveal.descripti: rare-ui grid-reveal: a self-splitting binary grid holds the spot until the image lands, then tints each cell with its average color and fades in the photo.
features.playground.gridReveal.generateD: Click to drive the split with progress 0→100%; at 100% the image "arrives" (generated locally on canvas, no external URL) and the component finishes on image landing.
features.playground.gridReveal.scenario: Waiting-and-reveal for AI image generation or uploads, avatar and cover loading states, gallery lazy-load placeholders.
features.playground.intro.zeroDependency: Zero new dependencies · reuses existing capabilities
features.playground.loaders.description: beUI loader: a single component with 17 loading variants (spinner, dots, bars, morph, Newton's cradle, terminal-style ASCII and more), scaling from one size prop, colored via currentColor, with every transform swapped for a calm opacity pulse under reduced motion.
features.playground.loaders.paramsDescri: Pick a variant, then tune size / cycle duration — the centered preview updates in real time.
features.playground.loaders.scenario: Waiting states for tables / dialogs / buttons, in-progress hints for command palettes and AI generation, status display in terminal-style UIs.
features.playground.loaders.variantsDesc: All 17 variants share one Loader component; the sliders tune size and cycle duration across the wall. ASCII variants swap glyphs per frame, the rest are motion keyframe animations.
features.playground.matrixOrb.descriptio: rare-ui matrix-orb: a Canvas 2D dot-matrix orb blending idle / listening / thinking states, with amplitude that can follow a real audio level.
features.playground.matrixOrb.scenario: Voice-assistant state indicator (idle / listening / thinking), AI chat loading states, in-call volume visualization.
features.playground.matrixOrb.stageDescr: States crossfade by weight rather than hard-cut; listening amplitude follows an auto envelope — turn it off to drive the level by hand.
features.playground.matrixOrb.trioDescri: The three states under the same color, for comparison.
features.playground.numberFlow.countdown: NumberFlowGroup keeps minutes and seconds in sync, digits caps the tens-of-seconds at 5, trend pinned downward.
features.playground.numberFlow.descripti: Official Number Flow: digits roll into place on change, with Intl formatting, prefix/suffix, trend direction and grouped sync.
features.playground.numberFlow.liveDescr: Random-walks every 1.5s to mimic online-user fluctuation; the timer pauses with keepAlive when you switch tabs.
features.playground.numberFlow.scenario: Dashboard KPI cards, live online counts, countdowns, cart totals, progress percentages — any number that changes.
features.playground.numberFlow.sliderDes: Drag the slider — the percentage and derived capacity roll in real time.
features.playground.numberFlow.stepperDe: Plus/minus and random drive one value: currency on the left follows the current locale, unit suffix on the right.
features.playground.placeholder: Demo page is under construction, stay tuned
features.playground.themeSwitchAnimation: Theme switch animation built on the View Transitions API: switching light/dark reveals the new theme through a shape mask (circle expand, directional wipe, polygon) instead of a hard cut.

This page switches the global theme — the same state source as the header theme picker and the logo light/dark variant, so the whole app follows. The badges below are the real capability probe of this environment.
Where the View Transitions API is unavailable (Safari < 18, Firefox < 144, etc.) or the system prefers reduced motion, the switch degrades to an instant change — the theme state stays correct.

Each of the 13 cards carries its own trigger button (a separate useThemeAnimation instance): the mask is centred on the circular button, so clicking at different grid positions shows the reveal origin following the trigger. In controlled mode every instance shares the same theme source.
Pick an animation, then tune duration / easing (CIRCLE_BLUR also exposes blur amount) and press the button to switch the theme with those settings. Changes apply to the next switch.
One animation type, three triggers at different horizontal positions: the new theme reveals from each button's own centre.
System light/dark switching (header theme picker, preferences) and branded theme transitions that need a shaped reveal.
Circle expand · centred on the trigger
Circle collapse · collapses to light, expands to dark
